blocking_function: module top;mailbox #(int) m=new;function automatic int f();int v;m.get(v);return v;endfunction initial $display("%d",f());endmodule
get_dynamic_element: module top;mailbox #(int) m=new;int v[];initial begin v=new[1];m.get(v[0]);end endmodule
get_const: module top;mailbox #(int) m=new;const int v=3;initial m.get(v);endmodule
get_class_mismatch: module top;class A;endclass class B;endclass mailbox #(A) m=new;B b;initial m.get(b);endmodule
put_class_mismatch: module top;class A;endclass class B;endclass mailbox #(A) m=new;B b=new;initial m.put(b);endmodule
aggregate_message: module top;typedef struct packed{bit[7:0] a;} T;mailbox #(T) m=new;T v;initial m.put(v);endmodule
blocking_ff: module top;mailbox #(int) m=new;int v;bit clk;always_ff @(posedge clk) m.get(v);endmodule
